blueprint.heading: The 4-Hour Clinic Blueprint
blueprint.subheading: Every minute is intentional. Here is how your 4-hour coached clinic unfolds.

steps.title: Meet, Greet & Full Warm-Up
steps.description: Meet Coach Cris and the community. Complete warm-up covering dinking, drops, volleys, baseline depth, serving, and returning.

steps.title: The First 3 Shots
steps.description: Master the serve, return, and 3rd shot drop or drive. Learn backspin and topspin off both forehand and backhand — 4 new weapons in your arsenal.

steps.title: Volleys & Pro Resets
steps.description: Learn punch, roll, and smash volleys to keep opponents back at the baseline, followed by reset mastery to slow down fast-paced balls like a pro.

steps.title: Footwork & Doubles Tournament
steps.description: Court coverage and dinking footwork drills, followed by a doubles mini-tournament where Coach Cris takes notes and delivers your personal action plan.

schedule.heading: 4-Hour Coached Clinic Curriculum
schedule.subheading: Developed by Coach Cris for maximum improvement, structured breaks, and personalized attention.

sessions.title: Meet & Greet & Full Warm-Up
sessions.description: Meet and greet Cris, the coach, and the rest of the community. Pickleball is a social sport at its heart. We will go through a complete warm-up: Dinking, Dropping, Volleying, Hitting Long balls, Serving and Returning. (Quick 1-min water break at the end).

sessions.title: The First 3 Shots
sessions.description: The most important shots in Pickleball: the Serve, the Return, and the 3rd shot. Technical and strategic aspects. Learn how to hit backspin and topspin off your backhand and forehand — 4 new weapons in your pickleball arsenal. (1-min water breaks between drills).

sessions.title: Punch, Roll and Smash Volleys
sessions.description: Work on how to attack and keep your opponent back at the baseline with these three tools. Learn exactly when to hit each of the three shots and for what tactical purpose. (1-min water breaks between drills).

sessions.title: Resets — Slow Down The Game Like A Pro
sessions.description: One of the most underrated and useful skills in Pickleball. Learn how to slow down fast-paced balls coming at you and your partner, off the bounce or off the volley when at the baseline or transition zone. (1-min water break between drills).

sessions.title: Court Positioning & Footwork
sessions.description: Who covers what part of the court and why, while working on where to position yourself while dinking. Learn how to use your feet to your Team's distinct advantage. (1-min water break between drills).

sessions.title: Doubles Tournament & Personal Coaching Notes
sessions.description: Hone all the skills learnt and experience the new strategic mindset while playing a doubles tournament with different players. Coach Cris assesses each individual's performance and writes your personalized list of things to work on. (1-min water break between matches).

genericFaqs.q: Is this clinic right for me if I'm 40+ or a beginner?
genericFaqs.a: Yes! Our first Toronto clinic is specifically designed for adult players (marketing focus 40+) who know the basic rules and want to build consistency, control, and court confidence without intimidation. No official rating is required.

genericFaqs.q: What is the coaching format and ratio?
genericFaqs.a: Every clinic has exactly 8 players across 2 dedicated courts (4 players per court). Coach Cris works continuously across both courts — providing an 8:1 player-to-coach ratio with live adjustments on the spot.

genericFaqs.q: What equipment do I need to bring?
genericFaqs.a: Bring your pickleball paddle, proper non-marking court/tennis shoes, athletic comfortable clothing, and a water bottle (32oz+). Pickleball balls, training cones, and targets are fully provided.

genericFaqs.q: Are there scheduled breaks during the 4 hours?
genericFaqs.a: Yes! Each drill block is punctuated by 1-minute water breaks, with time built in to rest, hydrate, and chat with fellow players. The pace is active yet comfortable.

genericFaqs.q: Where in Toronto is the clinic held and is there parking?
genericFaqs.a: The clinic is hosted at a premier dedicated indoor racquet facility in the Greater Toronto Area with ample free on-site parking. Exact facility address and arrival instructions are emailed to all 8 registered players immediately upon registration.

genericFaqs.q: What is the refund and cancellation policy?
genericFaqs.a: Because each clinic is strictly capped at 8 players, your spot is reserved exclusively for you. Cancellations made at least 7 days before clinic date receive a full refund or free transfer to a future date.
